title: Cancel a vehicle registration
summary: Find out how to cancel a vehicle registration in New South Wales, depending on your specific situation.
who_can_apply: The ability to cancel a vehicle registration depends on the specific circumstances, such as whether the vehicle is written off, if the cancellation is within NSW, or if it is from interstate.

faqs.q: How do I cancel a vehicle registration within NSW?
faqs.a: You can cancel a vehicle registration within NSW by following the steps provided for that specific situation.

faqs.q: What if my vehicle has been written off?
faqs.a: If your vehicle has been written off, you must cancel the registration using the dedicated process for written-off vehicles.

faqs.q: Can I cancel a registration if I moved from another state?
faqs.a: If you are cancelling a vehicle registration from interstate, there are specific steps you need to follow.
